integrity.independence_limit: This mathematical review is not independent and no external audit is asserted.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Complete symbolic graph-spectrum decomposition and directed matrix-tree/BEST enumeration, with independent finite exact checks q=2..6.

scientific_limitations: The count identifies only cyclic rotation of labeled oriented words, not alphabet relabeling or reversal.
Only length-three ordinary palindromes (first equals last letter) are excluded; the claim does not concern reverse-complement palindromes.
The all-alphabet theorem is proved from an invariant subspace decomposition, directed matrix-tree theorem and BEST; finite numerical verification alone does not prove it.
An unindexed equivalent specialization of non-backtracking graph methods remains a possible bibliographic risk.
title: Exact enumeration of nonpalindromic three-factor universal cycles
